text: {"assertions":["Loss divergence in ml/train/loop.py occurred specifically when the input list was empty.","The root cause was an error being swallowed by a bare except clause.","The fix involved narrowing the exception handler to allow failures to propagate properly.","Pull request #3998 on branch fix/loss-divergence-1 was created to address the issue.","The symptom of loss divergence was a loss curve that increased continuously and never returned to normal.","The fix was validated by training two epochs on the small data split.","P99 latency improved from 5.0 seconds to 631 milliseconds after applying the fix.","This work continued from earlier loss divergence investigation in the same code location."]}
